name: Unlimited Product Labels and Product Badges for WooCommerce – Elegant Labels
author: shibhuplugins

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store with stunning, eye-catching product labels and badges that drive sales and enhance customer experience. Elegant Labels for WooCommerce provides a comprehensive solution for creating beautiful, customizable labels that highlight special offers, new arrivals, bestsellers, and more.

Live Demo | Get PRO | PRO Demo

Main Features

✅ Unlimited Labels/Badges: Create unlimited product labels and badges
✅ Text labels: Create unlimited custom text product labels
✅ Text Variables: use text labels to display product information like stock status, stock quantity, coupon codes, discount percentage, sale ends in, shipping class, price, sold quantity and much more
✅ Shapes: 5 pre built text label shapes included.
✅ Image labels/badges: Create unlimited image label/badges.
✅ Custom image: Option to upload your custom image badge
✅ Better placements: Labels can be displayed in three place. 1. on product image, 2. on product image in product page, 3. Product page details
✅ Label Posotions: Place your label on top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right.
✅ Customize: Can customize label however you like. over 900+ Google fonts included. You can change Font, font size, background color, text color, writing mode, line height, letter spacing, margin and padding
✅ Conditions: show labels based on conditions like All products, specific products, based on product categories, based on product tags, based on price. Combine logic conditions to ‘AND’ and ‘OR’ groups to create more complex rules.
✅ Live Preview: Live preivew helps to create labels.
✅ Theme Support: Works with almost all themes.
✅ Responsive: Works in all mobile, gadgets and computers.
✅ Speed: Labels uses css only. plugin loads fast and doesn’t slow your website.

Premium Features

✅ Premium Shapes: 15+ pre built premium text label shapes included.
✅ Premium Image badges: 30+ pre built premium image labels
✅ Emojis: More than 500+ emojis included.
✅ More Conditions: More conditions included to create complex rules
✅ Dedicated support: Get dedicated supports from our site

Get PRO | PRO Demo
sections.installation:
1. Upload elegant-labels to the /wp-content/plugins/ folder
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Elegant Labels -> Add New and create your first label
